description: RGB en, 296 samples x 2 cases. One row per case with every scorer's score. variably_4_2_1: variA/Bly 4.2.1 faithfulness, scored 2026-10-24 through the full production path (semantic build d96c64f). ragas_faithfulness / deepeval_*: April 2026 scores (gpt-4o-mini judge) on the identical answer-and-passage pairs. deepeval_hallucination: higher = more hallucinated (inverted for approval). null = no score returned. variably_april_2026: the April 2026 scorer, kept for history.
